The Duel to the Death feature is unique to the World of Warcraft: Classic Hardcore and replaces the regular duel system since death is a permanent part of these realms. Challenging a player with this feature is equivalent to the orcish custom, "Mak'gora". To initiate this feature, right-click on the player's portrait and request the Duel to the Death from the menu or select the target and type /makgora in the chat. Before commencing combat, both parties will have to agree to an acknowledgment warning window. Players that come out victorious in a Duel to the Death will receive a new permanent String of Ears buff that increases by 1 with each new victory.

Following the Cataclysm the Dunemaul clan was brought into the Horde by Megs Dreadshredder and the Dunemaul "Emissary", who are stationed at the Dunemaul Recruitment Camp, through means of force and threats. Dungeon Finder is a tool for finding groups for 5-player dungeons, as well as a means of directly entering those instances. Dungeon Finder can be accessed through the Group Finder, found via a button on the micro menu at the bottom of the user interface. Dungeon Finder is unlocked at level 15. Dungeon Finder selects players to form a party from all servers in the battlegroup, so there need not be a full group of players on one specific realm. Note that it is not possible to queue for dungeons outside of the player's level bracket or expansion level; e.g. level 80 players cannot queue for classic or Burning Crusade dungeons. Durnholde Keep is a ruined stronghold located east of the town of Tarren Mill in the Hillsbrad Foothills. It used to be an internment camp and prison for the orcs. Along with its inner barracks, Durnholde also had a mage tower and an arena. The small village that encircled Durnholde was inhabited by those who made their living off tending to the needs of the fortress's inhabitants.

Dungeon has multiple meanings in World of Warcraft: # A general fantasy term for an adventuring area, often confined, that is inhabited with enemies (tombs, caves, castles, ruins, etc.). # Any instance, whether designed for a party or a raid. # An instance designed to be completed by a 5-man party. The rest of this article will focus on this sense of the term.

Dunemaul Compound is the ogre mound of the Dunemaul ogres of Tanaris. Their leader, Sandscraper, resides here in his cave. Megs Dreadshredder, located just east at the Dunemaul Recruitment Camp, tries to "recruit" these ogres into the Horde. During the Burning Legion's invasion, the camp falls under the Legion's control. Its residents are enslaved by nathrezim and are later killed by the defenders.
Duskbringer is a two-handed sword with a Shadow damage proc.

Duskbats are weak bats found outside Deathknell in Tirisfal Glades. Larger varieties can be found throughout the zone. They are sometimes hunted by the Forsaken of the town for their wings, which are used to make armor. Other species of Duskbat include Mangy Duskbat, Greater Duskbat, and Vampiric Duskbat.

Dungeon difficulty is a setting that increases the challenge and rewards of a 5-man dungeon instance at maximum level. As of Battle for Azeroth, dungeon difficulty includes Normal, Heroic, Mythic and Mythic+, each with progressively increasing difficulty. These settings have gradually been made available throughout the history of World of Warcraft, with the latest addition of Mythic+ in Legion.
Dungeon Set 3 is a type of item set. Each set consist of 5 pieces.

Durotan's Battle Harness is a plate chestpiece that was handed down through eleven generations of Frostwolf clan leaders. Crafted of heavy plate mail connected by chains, the harness bears the image of two white wolves facing one another on its front. The harness' last wearer was Durotan, who wore it during the orcs' assault on Telmor. It would have been passed down to Durotan's son and grandson, but at some point it was lost to time. Orgrim Doomhammer believed the harness to have been scavenged or lost to the elements.

A dupe or duplication comes in two forms. It can be either a program, which you run, or a method, in which instructions are passed around the internet on how to 'dupe'. There are also a few types of dupes: * Item dupe: a duplication method or program that dupes or copies item(s) you have * Gold dupe: a duplication method or program that dupes or copies an amount of gold you have Duping within the World of Warcraft is a breach of the Terms of Use, and can get your account permanently suspended.

When Durros Malfictin, a human knight, died, his corpse was experimented on by a necromancer. The necromancer tried to instill a small amount of sentience in the corpse so that it could lead larger groups of mutated corpses. A hideous abomination called the Carcass of Durross Malfactin was the result of the necromancer's experiment gone horribly wrong. Tiny as it was, the abomination's intelligence proved enough to surprise the necromancer: The Carcass killed the old mage as he slept. It is said to roam the Barrens in search of bodies to sew onto its already gargantuan corpse.

Dungeon & Raid Emblem was an dungeon & raid achievement given to players who receive an emblem from any of the Northrend 5-man heroic instances or raid instances. Emblems must be 'looted': * Emblems awarded for defeating a boss count. * Emblems awarded for completing a heroic through the Dungeon Finder do not. * Emblems looted from (eg) Keg-Shaped Treasure Chest, the Sack of Frosty Treasures or the Cache of the Ley-Guardian count. * Emblems awarded directly for completing (eg) the weekly raid quest do not.

A group of revolting Crushblow peons led by Foreman Magrok took over the holdout's main building and turned into a Peon Hideout. This hideout is only visible to Horde characters during the vulpera recruitment questline.

Dungeon Diplomat requires that, for each of the below dungeon factions, there be at least one guild member who has achieved reputation with that faction. Note that a faction is counted if a member has that reputation at exalted, regardless of where he stands in regards to the other factions. Also note that the member's guild reputation is not a factor.

Duskmist Shore was a coast of Gilneas, located southwest of Duskhaven. It served as the main initial landing ground for the Forsaken invasion of Gilneas. It was full of their combatants and catapults. Two Forsaken ships, captained by Captain Morris and Captain Anson, could be found here. Dark Ranger Thyala oversaw the invasion from the captured unnamed house belonging to the Walden family. This area, along with the Hammond Farmstead, were the first sections of Gilneas to fall into the sea.

The Durotar storyline picks up from the troll and orc starting experiences in Echo Isles and Valley of Trials, respectively. In it players travel North through Durotar, starting with Sen'jin Village in the South and ending at the Dranosh'ar Blockade leading into Orgrimmar.

Dusklight Hollow is found between the Dusklight Bridge and the Gao-Ran Battlefront of southern Townlong Steppes, high above Ambermarsh to the south. Base of Lao-Chin's Shado-Pan, Dusklight Hollow uses the hollowed out interior of the great tree, which fell to the soutwest some time ago, forming the Dusklight Bridge to Townlong Steppes. The passed through on the way from Hatred's Vice to Sik'vess, maddening the local scorpions. The Dusklight Initiates were ill-equipped to handle the Seething Fleshrippers, and were quickly cut down. Initiate Pao-Me alone survived the attack, as the main forces under Lao-Chin's command were at the Dusklight Bridge at the time.

The Dusklight Bridge was formed when the great tree that now comprises Dusklight Hollow fell over the Widening Deep in southwestern Townlong Steppes, bridging the chasm to Kor'vess in the Dread Wastes. Dusklight Rangers and skirmishers under the command of Lao-Chin the Iron Belly are fending off Kor'thik Timberhusks, streaming over the bridge. Further west is Rensai's Watchpost, and far to the north are the Lower Sumprushes.

The Dustbowl is a large area of the northwest of Badlands between kargath and valley of fangs (center of Badlands). It is home to a variety of species including coyotes, Rock Elementals, and buzzards. Some flora have been able to grow on the arid landscape such as a myriad of cacti and a few trees. This place also contains Camp Wurg.
Dustbelch Grotto is a large ogre mound in southwestern Badlands. It is home to the Dustbelcher ogres.

Dustwind Cave is a rather small cave in Durotar located atop the cliffs of Razorwind Canyon, just northeast of Razor Hill. This is where new members of the Burning Blade go to train under the Burning Blade Cultists.
Dustwind Gulch is located in the Badlands to the west of Lethlor Ravine.
The Dustbelcher ogres live in the Badlands, mostly found in Dustbelch Grotto.
Dusty Mining Gloves are a quest reward from Collecting Memories.

__NOTOC__ The Dusky Belt is a belt made by Leatherworkers that gives a bonus to agility and stamina.

Dusky Bracers are a product of Leatherworking. This item would be potentially useful to classes such as Hunter (pre-40), Rogue, or Druid that are looking to boost their agility in the wrist slot. The lack of other stats on this item could be supplemented with an enchant.

The Dust Plains are the southernmost area of Westfall. The plains have a population of gnolls that threaten adventurers from their few camps. An old mage tower known as Mortwake's Tower, recently taken over by mercenaries in the employ of Helix Gearbreaker, is located on the eastern edge of the plains. During the Burning Legion's invasion, the area falls under the Legion's control. Its residents are enslaved by nathrezim and are later killed by the defenders.
